The '''''Gambit''''' was a [[Luxury 2800]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. Originally belonging to a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] came into the possession of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after a clash between them and the crime lord's organization. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Amarith]], commander of [[Chiron Base]], claimed the vessel for herself. She loaned the vessel to a Rebel team investigating an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ando Project|operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].<ref name="Ando" />
